_: What shoot.js can render without signing in. 'public' expands to every path in public; 'present' to every moment in present (at 375/660/1280, plus 1920x1080 in each display profile). A unit adds its own fixture here (and in present/ or play/) as part of its work. API calls go to /__api/ (the stub config.js points API_BASE there) and are answered from these fixtures; anything unmatched gets a 404 JSON and is listed in the run log.
